title: Record page
summary: One record shown and edited on a page: the fields read as a pk-field-list, or as a validated pk-form (a pk-field-group per section card) in edit mode, beside sidebar cards (pk-detail-layout, which collapses on a phone). Set load(id) and save(values) as properties (business logic, never config data). load runs when config.id is set and shows the built-in loading, not-found and error (with Retry) states; without an id the page is a new record, in edit mode. save runs only after client validation passes; reject with { errors: { field: message } } to mark fields inline, or any other error for a notice above the form. While edits are unsaved, dirty is true, pk-record-dirty fires, and closing or reloading the tab asks first.

props.name: config
props.description: { id?, fields, values?, sections?, sidebar?, titleField?, heading?, saveLabel?, editable?, deletable?, label?, emptyHeading? }. deletable shows a Delete button of an existing record, in view and edit mode (pk-record-delete); the record page type sets it from its delete callback. fields are the field defs of pk-field-group, [{ key, label?, kind?, hint?, help?, required?, readonly?, disabled?, span?, options?, when?, ... }] (name and type are the older spellings of key and kind; in that spelling help is the line under the control): kind is a pk-input type (text, email, number, date...), textarea, select, checkbox, switch, range, combobox or custom (its body in edit mode is your child with slot editor-<key>) (options: strings or { value, label }). In edit mode the element draws them as one pk-field-group, so every member the group knows works here. values is the starting record of a new one (no id). sections and sidebar are [{ heading, fields: [keys] }], one card each (main column, beside it; fields no section or sidebar card names lead the main column under heading). Sidebar cards are editable in edit mode (same form, one Save); a field they name is edited there only. titleField is a field key whose loaded or saved value is the page title (title is the fallback). cancellable shows Cancel on a new record too. The host may set a beforeSave(values) property (a function, or async): it runs once the form is valid and before save, and returning false stops the save and keeps the page in edit mode with the edits (the place for a confirm of your own; the record page type takes it as config.beforeSave(values, ctx)). id selects the record to load; none means a new record. editable: false hides Edit. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: title?: string (the page heading; config.heading titles the field list), breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: mode
props.description: view reads the record; edit shows the form with Save and Cancel. Edit and a successful save switch it; a new record is always in edit mode.

props.name: deletable
props.description: Shows the Delete button of an existing record, in view and edit mode; pk-record-delete fires when it is pressed. The same as config.deletable (either one shows it).

props.name: cancellable
props.description: Shows Cancel on a new record too The same as config.cancellable.

props.name: busy
props.description: The host is working (a delete, a save it runs itself): Edit, Cancel, Save and Delete are disabled and Save shows its busy state, and a submit is ignored, until it is false again.

props.name: error
props.description: The host's error text, shown as a notice above the form (for example a failed delete); empty clears it. A rejected save shows its own notice in the same place.

props.name: dirty
props.description: The form differs from the last loaded or saved values. Read it; the element sets it.

slots.name: main-before
slots.description: Content placed above the field list or form in the main column (a PkCard section, a banner). Shown in view and edit mode.

slots.name: main-after
slots.description: Content placed below the field list or form in the main column (more PkCard sections). Shown in view and edit mode.

slots.name: side-after
slots.description: Content placed after the sidebar cards.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

events.name: pk-record-dirty
events.description: The unsaved-changes state changed. The app framework's record page type uses it to confirm before an in-app leave (link, breadcrumb, back/forward).

events.name: pk-record-cancel
events.description: Cancel was pressed; for a new record (id is null) the host decides where to go.

events.name: pk-record-save
events.description: save() resolved; values are the saved record.

events.name: pk-record-delete
events.description: The Delete button (shown for an existing record, in view or edit mode, when config.deletable is set) was pressed. The app framework's record page type asks first, calls its delete(id, ctx) and toasts; a host that uses the element alone handles the event.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The pk-detail-layout holding the main column and the sidebar.

parts.name: column
parts.description: The main column: the main-before slot, main, then the main-after slot.

parts.name: aside
parts.description: The sidebar column: side, then the side-after slot.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The field list or the form.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: Wraps the Edit, Cancel and Save buttons.

parts.name: cancel
parts.description: The Cancel button (edit mode of an existing record, or of a new one when cancellable).

parts.name: save
parts.description: The Save button (edit mode); busy while save() is in flight.

parts.name: delete
parts.description: The Delete button (an existing record, view or edit mode, when config.deletable is true); raises pk-record-delete.

parts.name: notice
parts.description: The save error, above the form.

parts.name: state
parts.description: The loading, not-found or load error state, in place of the record.

a11y: Fields are labelled pk-field controls; pk-form moves focus to the first invalid field and lists the problems in a summary, and a server error focuses its field. The loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles and announcements.

examples.title: Product record (set config, load and save from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP)
Sections around the fields (main-before, main-after, side-after)
examples.html: <pk-record-page id="product-sections"><pk-card slot="main-after" heading="Activity">Created by the import on 3 March.</pk-card><pk-card slot="side-after" heading="Related">Two open orders.</pk-card></pk-record-page>

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Loads the record again by config.id through load(id); called when the load callback is set after the page connected (the Blazor wrapper does).
